title: Dual formulations of geometric curvature flows and their discretizations
summary: We propose new formulations of geometric curvature flows -- referred to as \emph{dual formulations} -- that are equivalent to the original formulations but provide a novel framework for constructing linearly implicit and energy-stable schemes for curvature-driven surface evolution, including mean curvature flow, surface diffusion, and solid-state dewetting on a substrate with a moving contact line.
